name: Long Task Engine
description: Demo Executa for the anna.tools.invokeAsync job channel: a configurable multi-step long task (run_steps) that reports live progress via executa/progress notifications.
_comment: Publish metadata (slug/name/version/executa_type) is read by `anna-app apps publish`; the dev fields (tool_id/type/enabled) are read by `anna-app dev`. This dir is the `long-task-engine` handle referenced by app.json#bundled_executas. The plugin has no reverse-RPC capabilities — progress notifications ride the base invoke channel, so no grants are needed. To ship an installable binary, add a `binary` profile with binary_urls (see anna-app-aps-files-demo for the full pattern).
